item.title: Stellwerk 0.23.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a Usage tab beside Setup and Run shows Claude's limits (session, week, week per model) for each Claude account. A second account can be added in Settings → Agents with a token from `claude setup-token`; "Use" switches to it. Optionally, a turn that would draw on extra usage stops and carries on with an account that has room, or just stops. Mac only: the phones don't show limits yet.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: Install from source (Settings → Advanced). A row at the bottom of the sidebar builds Stellwerk from its project on this Mac, the default branch or a workspace, and installs it with a restart. Release updates keep coming: the next release replaces the build.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Experimental token hints (Mac: Settings → Experimental, on every device): in a big Claude chat, the message box suggests /compact after a long pause, when the cached context has expired, and offers to send a message that starts a separate task in a new chat (Haiku on the Mac judges while you type). Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android.

    • Patch Changes

  • #30 `69ce46e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Android: leaving a screen always ends its live feed; before, it could stay open in the background when the screen closed right after connecting.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the Team chats block under each project is gone; a people button next to the project's "+" opens Search on that project's teammates' sessions (People: Teammates). Search's filter shows "Team · Teammates" when People is set, and a project without rows yet shows its name instead of its id.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a downloaded update shows at the bottom of the sidebar ("Update available"), with "Install now" under the pointer. While agents are working it asks first, since the restart ends them.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Team: a session continued in a new workspace brings its chat along; the new chat showed nothing before (the agent knew the history, you didn't). Prompts from Conductor with attached files no longer show its instructions at the start.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.22.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #25 `18fa5eb` Thanks @fabifink! - Stellwerk for Mac: Claude chats can use Claude in Chrome again, as they could in Conductor. Settings → Agents → Claude in Chrome turns it on (on by default when the Claude extension is installed in Chrome or another Chromium browser), and the row says whether the extension was found. Chats that are running switch after their turn and keep their history. With it off, Claude tells you where to turn it on instead of quietly having no browser tools.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.22.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #22 `35a19d2` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: the to-do list is the main screen now, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android. Every to-do is one card that keeps its place through all its phases: a short title with the phase and a progress bar, where it stands in one line, the next step, and details folded away. An agent's question and the Operator's decisions show on the card as buttons (the recommended one starred) with an answer field, a ready PR gets a Merge button, and chips filter what needs you, what's to merge, what runs and what's put off (Later). The Operator's chat moved into a bar at the bottom (on the phones the second tab, after To-dos). The Operator writes the cards itself, nudges stuck workspaces, has clear review comments worked off, waits for checks and closes workspaces after a merge; merging and product decisions stay with you.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.21.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #19 `f8000ba` Thanks @fabifink! - Stellwerk for Mac: quitting, updating or restarting Stellwerk now ends its agents instead of leaving them running unseen, where they finished their turn (pushing, opening PRs) while the chat still showed the old state. A chat Stellwerk quit or crashed during comes back as failed and unread, with a note in the chat and the Operator's line "Interrupted: Stellwerk quit during the turn.", instead of a quiet idle chat that the Operator and its to-dos showed as "Idle". Agents a crash left running end at the next start.
  • #20 `4c705cc` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Chats open whole and stay put: pages start at a prompt and the first holds a few turns, Claude's thinking progress no longer fills the transcript, and on the Mac older messages load without the chat jumping.
  • #20 `4c705cc` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: pasted images and videos stay chips in your message (pasted-image.png); a click opens the image in a tab next to the chats.
  • #20 `4c705cc` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a merged PR shows Continue and Archive side by side, like Conductor.
  • #20 `4c705cc` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: an attachment in the message box shows ✕ under the pointer (a click removes it), and a pasted image shows itself above its chip, like Conductor.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.21.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #16 `861ef9a` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: checking off a to-do also archives its workspace when nothing is left in it. If a chat still works or asks, or there are uncommitted files or commits not pushed, you're asked first (Archive anyway / Keep workspace). The Operator can close workspaces too, with the same check, and only archives anyway with your OK.
  • #16 `861ef9a` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: while the Operator works on a to-do itself (a check, a look-up), the to-do says so ("Operator · Checks the PR's CI"). It goes away when the to-do is done or the Operator stops.

    • Patch Changes

  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - When Stellwerk isn't running on the Mac, the apps say so instead of "HTTP 502". A chat on the iPhone opens at its end. Every project with Entire shows its team chats block right away: a spinner while it loads, a refresh button when it's empty, and a failed load is retried after 10 seconds instead of a minute.
  • #18 `8dd7c9a` Thanks @fabifink! - Stellwerk for Mac: the host no longer stops answering when many git and command-line checks run at once, for example right after launch. Until now the Mac window, the phones and other Macs then couldn't reach it until Stellwerk was restarted.
  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a file attached to your message opens in a tab next to the chats, like changed files. Images and videos open in a lightbox over the window that closes with Esc, instead of the Quick Look panel, which sometimes showed the wrong item and then stopped opening.
  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: buttons like "Continue in new workspace" get the same corners as Create PR instead of a capsule.
  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the pointer turns into a hand over images and videos in the chat that open on click.
  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: filled buttons (Continue in new workspace, Restore, Clone, …) take the theme's colors like the send button instead of system blue.
  • #17 `d1cc462` Thanks @fabifink! - The Operator waits for a PR's checks: a chat that's done while its pull request's checks still run shows under "Checks running" (and in its to-do's line) instead of Ready, then moves to Ready when they pass or to Failed ("Checks failed.") when they don't. The Operator's status tool says so too. Mac, iOS and Android alike.
  • #2 `16b170e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - The project setup says "Team chats for this project" and what you get (your team can read and continue the agents' chats) instead of "Enable Entire"; Entire is named as how it works.
